title: OCM Carrier Type Definition v1.0
description: ADR-0031 D1: a carrier (pallet) as a first-class kind -- transcribed hardware with frames, geometry, joints, and meshes, and DELIBERATELY no state_machine, comms, or capabilities: a carrier has no controller, no states, and nothing to command it with. Per ADR-0014 the absent fields stay absent rather than acquiring placeholders; a manifest carrying them refuses OCM_CARRIER_TYPE_HAS_CONTROL. Identity and wear stay ADR-0020's carriers block -- a different question about the same object.

ocm_version.description: Spec version this manifest is written against.

revision.description: SemVer. MAJOR bump = breaking change to frames or joints.

license.description: SPDX identifier. Hardware should use CERN-OHL-S-2.0.

mount.description: The carrier's footprint on whatever locates it, if meaningful. A carrier declares no mounting interface -- it is placed by being located (ADR-0031 D2), not bolted.

footprint_mm.description: [x, y] envelope on the resting plane.

frames.description: Named coordinate frames. 'origin' is REQUIRED and is the carrier's own datum; all other frames are relative to it. `part_datum` -- where a correctly seated part's own origin lands -- becomes load-bearing with ADR-0031 D4 (part 2).

collision.description: Path to collision mesh. Convex hull or convex decomposition strongly preferred.

urdf_fragment.description: Path to a URDF snippet declaring this carrier's links and joints (e.g. a spring clamp's jaw).

com_mm.description: Center of mass in the origin frame.

rpy_deg.description: Fixed-axis roll-pitch-yaw, degrees. Matches URDF convention (which uses radians — the loader converts).
